ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with approximately 85% high-intensity white pixels and 15% low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels localized primarily at the margins and notch.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central and lateral regions dominated by uniform high-intensity white. A continuous dark-pigmented border follows the trailing edge. A distinct, vertically-oriented dark mottling cluster is centered at the median notch. Scattered low-intensity circular spots (mottling) are distributed bilaterally across the white fields.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped depression with an approximate 105-degree interior angle and a narrow bounding-box depth relative to the total fluke width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern along the entire trailing edge boundary, featuring jagged peaks and valleys with pixel-amplitudes of 2-7 pixels, becoming more pronounced and irregular toward the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical concave curve fitted to the trailing edge of both lobes, tapering from the median notch toward the lateral distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple dark circular pixel clusters (mottling) on the medial lobes. Dense, high-relief, high-intensity textured clusters (barnacles) are localized at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One prominent, curved reddish-brown linear disruption on the left lobe. Multiple parallel, dark linear rake marks are visible on the mid-section of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization at the lateral fluke tips; a distinct elongated reddish-brown mark on the ventral surface of the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique reddish-brown pigmentation within the linear scar on the left lobe, contrasting with the standard black/white palette of the fluke surface.
